items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: You know who I was trying to get when he was out of town? Count Bay.

ctx.x: Is there any club which ties in with this church in any way? I've never seen them buried with music from this church.

Well, no, we don't. We don't participate in no parades at all. You see, all we buried, that's why I don't want to have a service here. It's free here. See, we're all preaching is free. When they want to get married, married to Samuel, it's free. We don't charge. It's free. It's free. So many free things we do. I just come from Kansas City, Missouri. You know who I was trying to get when he was out of town? Count Bay. That's his own town, you know? Mm-hmm. Count Bay. Oh, the summer of the... You ever been to…
They're all the same. They're just a nice.
